messages:
client-dev: Hey all — running into a weird streaming/SSE edge. When our web client reconnects mid-response we sometimes get overlapping output: a short partial chunk followed by a repeated chunk, and customers are seeing double billing for the same logical completion. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex_cs: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a minimal repro and the headers you send on reconnect? rough timeline is helpful (how long between disconnect+reconnect). :eyes:

client-dev: Timeline: disconnect -> reconnect within 3–6s. We use automatic client retry (no backoff). We do NOT set an idempotency header currently. Sample SSE fragments from client logs: 

```
// Received before disconnect
event: chunk
data: {"seq":1,"text":"The quick brown "}

// Received partial after reconnect
event: chunk
data: {"seq":2,"text":"fox jump"}

// Then server re-sends from seq 2 onwards
event: chunk
data: {"seq":2,"text":"fox jumps over the lazy dog"}
```

client-dev: We see billing entries for both fragments and then the full completion.

alex_cs: That log is super helpful. Two quick hypotheses: 1) client replaying the same request without an idempotency key -> server treats it as a new generation and you get both partial + full billing. 2) resume semantics + server-side KV cache offset mismatch causing the server to re-emit overlapping tokens when it continues.

tyler_engineering: +1. Also check whether the client is sending any resume token or resume offset header on reconnect. If the client reconnects and doesn't pass the session/resume token, the runtime may start a fresh generation and you see overlap.

maria_support: Quick mitigation for customers: enable a client-side dedupe strategy that ignores repeated prefix text for ~5s during reconnects, and add an idempotency key per logical request. That reduces accidental double-renders while we investigate. :thumbsup:

client-dev: We can add Idempotency-Key. Do you recommend a server-side header name?

tyler_engineering: Use the Idempotency-Key header (common pattern). On our side we will treat identical idempotency keys within a short window as the same logical request and avoid double-charge if we can reconcile. For streaming, prefer a stable request id that survives reconnects. Also pass resume-token when reconnecting so the server can continue from the last acked index instead of restarting.

alex_cs: For repro: can you share the exact reconnect HTTP request you send? e.g. sample cURL for reconnect path (replace tokens):

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \u005C\u000A     -H "Idempotency-Key: 123e4567-clientreq-1" \u005C\u000A     -H "Resume-Token: s:abcd1234:offset=6" \u005C\u000A     "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-test"
```

alex_cs: If Resume-Token is absent we fallback to a new generation. If present we try to resume; misaligned offsets can still cause small overlap (server will retransmit from the nearest committed token).

billing-bot: FYI billing: token billing is per delivered output chunk. If a client sees the same content twice (two successful generation fragments), they will count as two billable outputs. We can issue adjustments if we verify duplication is caused by a server-side bug. Please open a support case with session id and timestamps.

client-dev: Understood. We'll add Idempotency-Key and Resume-Token. If that doesn't stop it, we'll capture a HAR and the session IDs.

tyler_engineering: Action items: 1) client-dev to add idempotency + resume-token and try with a 200ms jittered backoff on reconnects; 2) alex_cs to correlate session id + ingress logs for the times you saw double billing; 3) rachel_sre to run a quick query for spikes of duplicate seq re-emits in the last 24h.

rachel_sre: Running the metric now. If we see > 0.5% reconnect-overlap rate we'll escalate to eng-runtime. Posting results to #incidents once done.

maria_support: For the customer-facing side I'll prepare a short note explaining expected behavior + immediate mitigation (idempotency + dedupe) and the refund path if billing already occurred.

alex_cs: Thanks everyone. client-dev — once you paste a repro (minimal script) I'll onboard tyler to reproduce locally and we can open an internal bug if needed. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:
summary: Client reports overlapping partial + full streaming outputs after reconnect causing duplicate billing; CS and eng recommend idempotency keys, resume tokens, and client-side dedupe as immediate mitigations; action items assigned to reproduce, query metrics, and prepare customer communication.
